title: Irrationality Exponents of Real CM Elliptic Periods and Powers of the Lemniscate Period
summary: We give a determinant proof that every nonzero real period of a nonsingular elliptic curve over $\mathbb Q$ with complex multiplication, measured with a specified nonzero rational invariant differential, has irrationality exponent two. The proof uses an integral origin chart, matched local lengths, an actual compactification and weighted packet map, and arithmetic and analytic estimates for the same selected minor on a rectangular sublattice of the full CM period lattice.
